subject: SIG: concise HSM rotation & TLS transit evidence (compact packet)
messages:
From: Eli Ramirez <eli.ramirez@windsorbank.com>
To: mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
Cc: claire.oneil@windsorbank.com
Date: 2028-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SIG request — compact HSM + TLS rotation evidence

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the demo last week. Windsor's SIG review has a follow-up: the assurance team would like a compact evidence packet that shows (a) HSM/operator shift logs covering the last rotation window, (b) TLS session traces demonstrating PFS in transit for customer endpoints, and (c) the rotation playbook and operator custody matrix with signatures. We don't need a full archive — a concise bundle that proves controls were executed is ideal.

Specific asks:
- A CSV export of HSM shift logs (operator, timestamp, action, reason) for the past 90 days.
- TLS session trace samples that show ephemeral key negotiation (server-side) for customer-facing endpoints (prod).
- The rotation playbook version used for the latest KEK rewrap and the signed operator matrix.

Can you confirm if Redwood can provide a compact packet (SFTP or presigned S3 link) and an expected delivery ETA? We need this for our SIG review next Wednesday. If there are sensitive pieces that require an NDA/secure channel, call that out and we'll coordinate.

Appreciate it — Eli
Security Engineering — Windsor Bank

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eli Ramirez <eli.ramirez@windsorbank.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-12-01T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG request — compact HSM + TLS rotation evidence

Eli — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble a compact evidence packet and will scope redactions where necessary. High level plan:

- Ben will pull HSM shift logs and a CSV export scoped to operator events tied to KEK/KEK-wrap rotations.
- Jonas will prepare TLS session trace samples (anonymized IPs, retains cipher suites and TLS params demonstrating ECDHE/PFS).
- I'll export the rotation playbook (v3) and the signed operator matrix; we'll mark operator identifiers according to Windsor's preference (full names or initials).

We can deliver via presigned S3 + short-lived SFTP credential. If Windsor needs an NDA addendum for operator transcripts, flag it now — otherwise we'll package with minimal identifying data.

Proposed ETA: 48 hours for the first compact bundle (attachments + manifest). If that works for your SIG window, we'll proceed.

Onward — Mina
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-12-02T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG request — compact HSM + TLS rotation evidence

On Fri, Dec 1, 2028 at 11:02 AM Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Eli — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble a compact evidence packet and will scope redactions where necessary.

All — attaching the manifest of artifacts I'm preparing. Quick notes:

- hsm_shiftlog_2028Q4.csv (CSV with columns: timestamp, operator_id, action, key_id, rotation_tag, note). Redacted operator emails; includes operator IDs and signed shift entries.
- tls_session_traces_nov_2028.zip (sampled pcap-like JSONs showing TLS handshakes; all client IPs anonymized as 10.x.x.x; server cert chain + negotiated cipher suites included).
- rotation_playbook_v3.pdf (procedural steps, timestamps, verification checklists).
- operator_matrix_signed.pdf (signed PDF with operator names/roles and signature timestamp).

Questions for Windsor: do you want operator identifiers fully redacted or initials only? Also, confirm the environment: you asked for "prod" — we will include prod-facing endpoints only unless you want stage included.

I'll stage these into a secure bucket and share a presigned link once Mina signs off on redactions. ETA remains ~48 hours from Mina's go-ahead.

— Ben
Principal, Security Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Eli Ramirez <eli.ramirez@windsorbank.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire O'Neil <claire.oneil@windsorbank.com>, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-12-03T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG request — compact HSM + TLS rotation evidence

Mina / Ben — thanks. Prod-only is correct. For operator identifiers, initials are fine — we only need to verify separation of duties, not PII. We prefer the S3 presigned link (short TTL) and an SFTP fallback in case of automated ingestion issues on our side.

Can you include a short manifest README in the bundle that maps artifacts to our SIG checklist items (SOC 2/CAIQ references)? That will speed our review. Also, please include any hash/checksum for each artifact (SHA256) so we can validate integrity on download.

If you can get the compact packet to us by EOD Monday (2028-12-04) that will close the SIG item. If anything requires an NDA, we'll get that started, but it doesn't look required given the planned redactions.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Eli
Security Engineering — Windsor Bank
